For Petitioner : Mr.R.Murali  For Respondents : Mr.K.Balasubramani
Special Government Pleader  ORDER Heard both sides.
2.The petitioner's lands are sought to be acquired under the provisions of Central Act 30 of 2013.
Notification under Section 11(1) of the Act was issued in September 2023.
The petitioner's apprehension is that compensation may not be properly determined.
3.I cannot assume for a moment that the competent authority will not properly discharge his statutory functions.

4.The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner specifically states that a number of coconut saplings are there on ground and that they have to be counted to the last.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 5.The learned Special Government Pleader would claim that these saplings were planted only recently.
6.I do not go into these contentious aspects.
The respondents are obliged to take a proper and pucca inventory of all the coconut plants that are on ground.
Photographs as well as videograph will be taken.
As and when the award is passed on merits and in accordance with law, it shall be communicated immediately to the petitioner.
The authorities should not mechanically deposit the award amount in the Court deposit.
If there is no dispute regarding title or apportionment, the money will have to be paid directly to the petitioner.
7.With these directions, this writ petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
